  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterIndustryJobs is called, the client shall return job details
    Given a character with active industry jobs
    When the client calls getCharacterIndustryJobs
    Then the client shall return job details including status and blueprint info

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterIndustryJobs returns no results, the client shall return an empty array
    Given a character with no industry jobs
    When the client calls getCharacterIndustryJobs for empty result
    Then the client shall return an empty array

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationIndustryJobs is called, the client shall return corporation jobs
    Given a corporation with running industry jobs
    When the client calls getCorporationIndustryJobs
    Then the client shall return the full list of corporation jobs

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getIndustryFacilities is called, the client shall return facility data
    Given industry facilities exist in the universe
    When the client calls getIndustryFacilities
    Then the client shall return facilities with location and tax info

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getIndustrySystems is called, the client shall return cost indices
    Given solar systems with industry activity
    When the client calls getIndustrySystems
    Then the client shall return cost index data per activity

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCharacterMiningLedger is called, the client shall return mining data
    Given a character who has been mining
    When the client calls getCharacterMiningLedger
    Then the client shall return daily ore quantities

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationMiningObservers is called, the client shall return observer list
    Given a corporation with mining observers
    When the client calls getCorporationMiningObservers
    Then the client shall return observer details

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationMiningObserver is called, the client shall return mining entries
    Given a valid mining observer
    When the client calls getCorporationMiningObserver
    Then the client shall return character mining entries

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF the token is invalid or expired, THEN the client shall throw a 403 error for industry jobs
    Given an invalid or expired token
    When the client calls getCharacterIndustryJobs without valid auth
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for industry jobs

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF corporation roles are insufficient, THEN the client shall throw a 403 error for mining observers
    Given insufficient corporation roles
    When the client calls getCorporationMiningObservers without roles
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403 for mining observers

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN industry jobs, facilities, and systems are fetched concurrently, all shall resolve successfully
    Given an authenticated character for concurrent industry fetch
    When the client fetches industry jobs, facilities, and systems in parallel
    Then all three industry requests shall resolve successfully
"}
